form.label: L2T - Network Connection Forensics
form.description: Comprehensive network connection analysis from Windows registry artifacts for digital forensics

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | stats count by source_long | sort source_long
index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "SSID:\s*(?<ssid>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "RemoteServer:\s*(?<remote_server>[^\s]+)" | eval network_identifier=coalesce(ssid, remote_server, "Unknown") | stats dc(network_identifier)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats dc(hostname)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-24h") | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval connection_category=case( like(source_long, "*WiFi*") OR like(message, "*WiFi*"), "WiFi", like(source_long, "*Wired*") OR like(message, "*Wired*"), "Wired", like(source_long, "*Drive*") OR like(message, "*Drive*"), "Network Drive", like(source_long, "*VPN*") OR like(message, "*VPN*"), "VPN", like(message, "*SSID*"), "Wireless", like(message, "*RemoteServer*"), "File Share", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by connection_category

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count by source_long | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "SSID:\s*(?<ssid>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "Description:\s*(?<network_desc>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "RemoteServer:\s*(?<remote_server>[^\s]+)" | eval network_name=coalesce(ssid, network_desc, remote_server, "Unknown") | where network_name!="Unknown" AND network_name!="" | stats count by network_name | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count by hostname | sort -count | head 10

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "SSID:\s*(?<ssid>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "RemoteServer:\s*(?<remote_server>[^\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "DriveLetter:\s*(?<drive_letter>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "Default Gateway Mac:\s*(?<gateway_mac>[^\s]+)" | eval risk_level=case( like(message, "*open*") OR like(message, "*unsecured*"), "High", match(ssid, "(?i).*(guest|public|free|temp).*"), "Medium", match(remote_server, "(?i).*(temp|test|dev).*"), "Medium", like(message, "*external*") OR like(message, "*internet*"), "Medium", match(drive_letter, "[a-zA-Z]:") AND like(remote_server, "*external*"), "High", like(timestamp_desc, "*night*") OR like(timestamp_desc, "*weekend*"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval network_identifier=coalesce(ssid, remote_server, "Unknown") | where risk_level!="Low" | stats count, values(source_long) as connection_types, values(drive_letter) as drive_letters, values(gateway_mac) as gateway_macs, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by network_identifier, hostname, risk_level | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort risk_level

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search message="*DriveLetter*" | rex field=message "DriveLetter:\s*(?<drive_letter>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "RemoteServer:\s*(?<remote_server>[^\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "RemotePath:\s*(?<remote_path>[^\s\n]*)" | where isnotnull(drive_letter) | eval server_risk=case( match(remote_server, "(?i).*(external|internet|temp|test).*"), "High", match(remote_server, "(?i).*(dev|staging).*"), "Medium", like(remote_server, "*corp*") OR like(remote_server, "*domain*"), "Low", true(), "Medium" ) | stats count, values(remote_path) as remote_paths, values(timestamp_desc) as timestamp_types, earliest(_time) as first_mapped, latest(_time) as last_accessed by drive_letter, remote_server, hostname, server_risk | eval first_mapped=strftime(first_mapped, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_accessed=strftime(last_accessed, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort server_risk, drive_letter

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search (message="*SSID*" OR message="*WiFi*" OR message="*Wireless*") | rex field=message "SSID:\s*(?<ssid>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "Description:\s*(?<network_desc>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "Connection Type:\s*(?<connection_type>[^\n]+)" | rex field=message "Default Gateway Mac:\s*(?<gateway_mac>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "DNS Suffix:\s*(?<dns_suffix>[^\s\n]+)" | where isnotnull(ssid) | eval security_assessment=case( like(ssid, "*guest*") OR like(ssid, "*public*"), "Low Security", like(ssid, "*corp*") OR like(ssid, "*domain*"), "Corporate", like(connection_type, "*Wired*"), "Wired Connection", like(connection_type, "*Wireless*"), "Wireless Connection", true(), "Unknown" ) | stats count, values(connection_type) as connection_types, values(gateway_mac) as gateway_macs, values(dns_suffix) as dns_suffixes, earliest(_time) as first_connection, latest(_time) as last_connection by ssid, network_desc, hostname, security_assessment | eval first_connection=strftime(first_connection, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_connection=strftime(last_connection, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval hour=strftime(_time, "%H") | eval day=strftime(_time, "%A") | stats count by day, hour | eval day_order=case( day=="Monday", 1, day=="Tuesday", 2, day=="Wednesday", 3, day=="Thursday", 4, day=="Friday", 5, day=="Saturday", 6, day=="Sunday", 7 ) | sort day_order, hour

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "Default Gateway Mac:\s*(?<gateway_mac>[0-9a-fA-F:]+)" | rex field=message "Mac:\s*(?<mac_address>[0-9a-fA-F:]+)" | eval mac_addr=coalesce(gateway_mac, mac_address) | where isnotnull(mac_addr) AND mac_addr!="" | rex field=mac_addr "^(?<oui>[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})" | eval vendor=case( oui=="00:50:56", "VMware", oui=="00:0C:29", "VMware", oui=="08:00:27", "VirtualBox", oui=="00:15:5D", "Microsoft Hyper-V", oui=="00:1C:42", "Parallels", true(), "Unknown/Physical" ) | stats count, values(hostname) as connected_hosts, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by mac_addr, vendor | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:Network" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ source_long=$connectionTypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (message="*$networkSearch$*" OR description="*$networkSearch$*" OR display_name="*$networkSearch$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "SSID:\s*(?<ssid>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "RemoteServer:\s*(?<remote_server>[^\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "DriveLetter:\s*(?<drive_letter>[^\s]+)" | rex field=message "Connection Type:\s*(?<connection_type>[^\n]+)" | rex field=message "Default Gateway Mac:\s*(?<gateway_mac>[^\s]+)" | eval network_identifier=coalesce(ssid, remote_server, "Unknown") | eval activity_risk=case( like(message, "*guest*") OR like(message, "*public*"), "High", match(network_identifier, "(?i).*(temp|test|external).*"), "Medium", like(connection_type, "*Wired*") AND like(network_identifier, "*corp*"), "Low", true(), "Medium" ) | eval connection_summary=case( isnotnull(ssid), "WiFi: " + ssid, isnotnull(remote_server), "Drive: " + drive_letter + " -> " + remote_server, true(), "Network Connection" ) | table datetime, hostname, source_long, timestamp_desc, connection_summary, connection_type, gateway_mac, activity_risk | sort activity_risk
